extraction.Name: John Flood
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded June 1, 1918 by R. E. Wang
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612679 issued; Southwest quarter section 24, township 38, north of range 27; receipt for patent signed January 23, 1918, by the allottee; John Flood conveyed the land by deed to W. H. Tackett on July 7, 1919. Document also contains entry for Louise Flood, Allotment No. 2960: Southeast quarter section 24, township 38, north of range 27; Fee patent No. 612680 issued December 29, 1917; receipt for patent signed April 29, 1918, by the allottee; patent returned to Washington with request for cancellation with the request that private sale be arranged; on May 16, 1918, C. L. Dice recorded the patent; on May 13, 1918, Louise Flood conveyed the land by deed to W. H. Tackett for $2400.
